title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Discover the unique rituals and long-standing traditions of Allegheny College, from the legendary 13th plank to the symbolic burning of the Senior Comp.

cards.title: Stealing the 13th Plank
cards.subtitle: A bridge of legends and missing wood
cards.notes: Locate the 13th plank on this historic wooden bridge. Tradition dictates that freshmen men steal it to prevent a jinx on their dating lives for the year.
cards.short_summary: A campus landmark where students traditionally steal the 13th plank to ward off a social superstition.
cards.evidence_claim: Legend has it that if a freshman woman is kissed on the thirteenth plank by an upperclassman, the men of the freshmen class will remain dateless; subsequently, freshmen men steal the plank.
cards.source_title: A love letter to the Rustic Bridge - The Campus
cards.access_notes: The bridge is located in the lower ravine on the south side of campus and is accessible 24/7.

cards.title: Burning of the Comps
cards.subtitle: A fiery end to senior year research
cards.notes: Join seniors during Senior Week as they toss copies of their Senior Comprehensive Projects into a ceremonial bonfire to celebrate academic completion.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing tradition where graduating seniors burn copies of their required Senior Comprehensive Projects.
cards.evidence_claim: The 'Burning of the Comps' is a College tradition dating back at least to the late 1800s, celebrating the conclusion of the seniors' academic work.
cards.access_notes: Typically held on the Gator Quad or near Brooks Hall during Senior Week in May.

cards.title: Gator Day
cards.subtitle: Classes canceled for professional growth
cards.notes: Participate in this class-free day dedicated to workshops and community building. It often coincides with Election Day to encourage civic engagement.
cards.short_summary: An annual tradition where classes are canceled for a day of professional development and community activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Gator Day is an annual fall and spring tradition at Allegheny where classes are canceled, and students attend sessions designed for development.
cards.access_notes: Events take place across various campus buildings including the Henderson Campus Center.

cards.title: The Run Out
cards.subtitle: A spirited Greek life introduction
cards.notes: Watch as new members of fraternities and sororities 'run out' of Brooks Hall into the circle to be greeted by their organizations with cheers.
cards.short_summary: A high-energy event where Greek organizations introduce their newest members to the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: Each fraternity and sorority introduces its new members at Run-Out; members 'run out' of Brooks Hall into Brooks Circle.
cards.access_notes: Occurs at the beginning of each semester in the circle outside Brooks Hall.

cards.title: Wingfest
cards.subtitle: The ultimate wing-eating competition
cards.notes: Head to the Gator Quad for the annual wing-eating contest and community feast featuring local Meadville flavors and themed festivities.
cards.short_summary: An annual fall festival centered around a competitive wing-eating contest and community dining.
cards.evidence_claim: Wingfest is an annual event hosted by Gator Activities Programming featuring a wing-eating competition and wings from local establishments.
cards.source_title: Wingfest 2025: Winner winner wing dinner - The Campus
cards.access_notes: Held annually in the fall on the Gator Quad; open to all students.

cards.title: Competition of the Muses
cards.subtitle: Greek life performance showcase
cards.notes: Attend this choreographed performance event where Greek organizations compete in singing and dancing, formerly known as Greek Sing.
cards.short_summary: A traditional performance competition between fraternities and sororities held during Blue and Gold Weekend.
cards.evidence_claim: Competition of the Muses (formerly Greek Sing) involves fraternities and sororities performing choreographed songs and acts in Shafer Auditorium.
cards.access_notes: Located inside the Henderson Campus Center; typically held on Friday evening of Blue and Gold Weekend.

cards.title: Senior Circle Legacy
cards.subtitle: Honoring the graduating class
cards.notes: Visit the monument where senior classes are recognized for their collective gift to the college, marking their transition to alumni status.
cards.short_summary: A physical monument on campus that records the legacy and contributions of each graduating senior class.
cards.evidence_claim: Senior classes who give are noted on the Senior Circle monument, representing their first legacy of giving to Allegheny College.
cards.source_title: Class Traditions at Allegheny | Maytum Center for Academic Success
cards.access_notes: Located near the top of Brooks Walk; accessible to the public.

cards.title: Matriculation Ceremony
cards.subtitle: The formal start of the journey
cards.notes: Witness the traditional welcome for first-year students as they are formally inducted into the Allegheny community of scholars.
cards.short_summary: The official ceremony marking the beginning of a student's academic career at Allegheny College.
cards.evidence_claim: Matriculation is the traditional beginning of students' academic journey at Allegheny College, serving as their formal welcome.
cards.source_title: Gator Week of Welcome Celebrates Community, Tradition - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Usually held in Ford Memorial Chapel or Shafer Auditorium during orientation week.

cards.title: Chompers the Gator
cards.subtitle: A mascot born from alliteration
cards.notes: Look for Chompers at athletic events. The alligator mascot was chosen in 1925 simply for the alliterative value of 'Allegheny Alligator.'
cards.short_summary: The official mascot of Allegheny College, representing a century-old student-led naming tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: The name 'Alligator' was selected in 1925 purely for the alliterative value; the current mascot is named Chompers.
cards.source_title: Alligator Evolution | Merrick Archives - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Appears at home games in the Wise Sport and Fitness Center and Robertson Athletic Complex.

cards.title: Springfest
cards.subtitle: The biggest weekend of the spring
cards.notes: Celebrate the end of the academic year with a weekend of concerts, games, and themed activities organized by Gator Activities Programming.
cards.short_summary: An annual spring festival featuring major concerts and campus-wide celebrations.
cards.evidence_claim: Springfest is an annual Allegheny tradition featuring a weekend full of events, including a major concert in the Wise Center.
cards.source_title: GAP announces 'Super Springfest' events - The Campus
cards.access_notes: Events are held across campus, with the main concert typically in the Wise Center.
